<script>
    // 遊客訪問必要取得的cookie，會在未登入購買時傳給cart那端
    (function () {
        function getCookie(name) {
            const value = '; ' + document.cookie;
            const parts = value.split('; ' + name + '=');
            if (parts.length === 2) return decodeURIComponent(parts.pop().split(';').shift());
            return null;
        }

        function setCookie(name, value, days) {
            const expires = new Date();
            expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + ';expires=' + expires.toUTCString() + ';path=/';
        }

        try {
            if (!getCookie('guest_id')) {
                const ts = Date.now();
                const rnd = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
                const guestId = '' + ts + rnd;
                setCookie('guest_id', guestId, 30);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('guest_id cookie setup failed', e);
        }
    })();
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const socialIcon = document.querySelector('.social-icon.active');
        const accountContent = document.querySelector('.header_account-content');
        if (!socialIcon || !accountContent) return;

        socialIcon.addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
            accountContent.style.display = 'flex';
        });

        accountContent.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
            accountContent.style.display = 'none';
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    // 搜尋列（輸入框 → X 清除 → 放大鏡按鈕送出），沿用 header_v3_prototype.html 的互動邏輯
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const executeSearch = (query, src) => {
            if (!query) return;
            window.location.href = `/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&src=${encodeURIComponent(src)}`;
        };

        document.querySelectorAll('.header_search-container').forEach(function (container) {
            const input = container.querySelector('.header_search-input');
            const clearBtn = container.querySelector('.header_search-clear');
            const submitBtn = container.querySelector('.header_search-submit');
            if (!input || !clearBtn || !submitBtn) return;

            function syncHasValue() {
                container.classList.toggle('has-value', input.value.trim().length > 0);
            }
            syncHasValue();
            input.addEventListener('input', syncHasValue);

            clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                input.value = '';
                syncHasValue();
                input.focus();
            });

            submitBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                executeSearch(input.value.trim(), input.getAttribute('data-search-bar') || 'navbar');
            });
            input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    executeSearch(input.value.trim(), input.getAttribute('data-search-bar') || 'navbar');
                }
            });
        });

        // 手機/平板：Menu 內搜尋匡預設收合，由 Menu Header 放大鏡展開/收合；
        // 外部搜尋圖示開 Menu 時直接以展開狀態呈現
        const searchToggle = document.querySelector('.tf-hd2-search-toggle');
        const navbarToggle = document.querySelector('.navbar-toggle');
        const menuSearch = document.querySelector('.tf-hd2-menu-search');
        const menuSearchToggle = document.querySelector('.tf-hd2-menu-search-toggle');
        const menuInput = menuSearch ? menuSearch.querySelector('.header_search-input') : null;

        function openMenuSearch(instant) {
            if (!menuSearch) return;
            if (instant) menuSearch.classList.add('tf-hd2-no-anim');
            menuSearch.classList.add('is-open');
            if (menuSearchToggle) {
                menuSearchToggle.classList.add('is-active');
                menuSearchToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            }
            if (instant) {
                requestAnimationFrame(function () { menuSearch.classList.remove('tf-hd2-no-anim'); });
            }
        }

        function closeMenuSearch() {
            if (!menuSearch) return;
            menuSearch.classList.remove('is-open');
            if (menuSearchToggle) {
                menuSearchToggle.classList.remove('is-active');
                menuSearchToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            }
        }

        if (menuSearchToggle && menuSearch) {
            menuSearchToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (menuSearch.classList.contains('is-open')) {
                    closeMenuSearch();
                } else {
                    openMenuSearch(false);
                    if (menuInput) menuInput.focus();
                }
            });
        }

        if (searchToggle && navbarToggle) {
            searchToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
                navbarToggle.click();
                openMenuSearch(true);
                setTimeout(function () { if (menuInput) menuInput.focus(); }, 350);
            });
        }

        if (navbarToggle) {
            let mobileMenuOpen = false;
            navbarToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
                mobileMenuOpen = !mobileMenuOpen;
                if (!mobileMenuOpen) closeMenuSearch();
            });
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    // 一級導覽：桌機 hover 展開／手機平板點擊右滑；沿用 header_v3_prototype.html 的互動邏輯
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const isMobile = function () { return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)').matches; };
        const items = document.querySelectorAll('.tf-hd2-has-children');

        function closeAll(except) {
            items.forEach(function (li) {
                if (li !== except) {
                    li.classList.remove('tf-hd2-open');
                    const a = li.querySelector(':scope > a');
                    if (a) a.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                }
            });
        }

        items.forEach(function (li) {
            const toggle = li.querySelector(':scope > a.dropdown-toggle');
            let closeTimer = null;

            li.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
                if (isMobile()) return;
                clearTimeout(closeTimer);
                closeAll(li);
                li.classList.add('tf-hd2-open');
                if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            });
            li.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
                if (isMobile()) return;
                clearTimeout(closeTimer);
                closeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    li.classList.remove('tf-hd2-open');
                    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                }, 250);
            });

            if (toggle) {
                toggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    if (!isMobile()) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    closeAll(li);
                    li.classList.add('tf-hd2-open');
                    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                });
            }

            const backBtn = li.querySelector('.tf-hd2-panel-back');
            if (backBtn) {
                backBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    li.classList.remove('tf-hd2-open');
                    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                });
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.tf-hd2-mega-grid').forEach(function (grid) {
            const cats = grid.querySelectorAll(':scope > .tf-hd2-mega-cat');
            cats.forEach(function (cat) {
                const head = cat.querySelector('.tf-hd2-mega-cat-head');
                if (!head) return;
                head.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    if (!isMobile()) return;
                    const wasOpen = cat.classList.contains('tf-hd2-acc-open');
                    cats.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('tf-hd2-acc-open'); });
                    if (!wasOpen) cat.classList.add('tf-hd2-acc-open');
                });
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    /**
     * Cart Dropdown Interaction Logic（沿用既有 v2 購物車邏輯，class 名稱未變）
     */
    window.getCartCookieName = function () {
        const locale = 'en';
        const languageMap = { 'zh-tw': 'tw', 'zh-cn': 'en', 'en': 'en' };
        const langSuffix = languageMap[locale] || 'en';
        return 'cart_' + langSuffix;
    };

    window.getCookie = function (name) {
        const value = '; ' + document.cookie;
        const parts = value.split('; ' + name + '=');
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            return decodeURIComponent(parts.pop().split(';').shift());
        }
        return null;
    };

    window.isInCart = function (packageId) {
                    const cartCookieName = window.getCartCookieName();
            const guestCart = window.getCookie(cartCookieName);
            if (guestCart) {
                try {
                    const cartData = JSON.parse(guestCart);
                    return cartData.some(function (item) { return item.package_id == packageId; });
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('檢查購物車失敗:', e);
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return false;
            };

    function getCookie(name) {
        const value = '; ' + document.cookie;
        const parts = value.split('; ' + name + '=');
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            return decodeURIComponent(parts.pop().split(';').shift());
        }
        return null;
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, minutes) {
        if (minutes === 0) {
            document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + ';path=/';
        } else {
            const expires = new Date();
            expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + minutes * 60 * 1000);
            document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + ';expires=' + expires.toUTCString() + ';path=/';
        }
    }

    function mergeCartData(existingItems, newItems) {
        const cartMap = new Map();
        existingItems.forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.package_id) cartMap.set(String(item.package_id), item);
        });
        newItems.forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.package_id && !cartMap.has(String(item.package_id))) {
                cartMap.set(String(item.package_id), item);
            }
        });
        return Array.from(cartMap.values());
    }

    function updateCartDisplay(cartData) {
        const itemsContainer = document.querySelector('.cart-dropdown-items');
        const countBadge = document.querySelector('.cart-count-badge');
        const totalAmount = document.querySelector('.cart-total-amount');
        // 桌機/手機選單各有一顆 .cart-button，querySelector 只會抓到第一顆，另一顆紅燈狀態永遠不會更新
        const cartButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.cart-button');

        if (!cartData || cartData.length === 0) {
            cartButtons.forEach(function (btn) { btn.classList.remove('has-items'); });
            if (itemsContainer) itemsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center" style="padding: 40px 0; color: #999; font-size: 14px;">Your cart is empty</div>';
                            if (countBadge) countBadge.textContent = '0 items';
                if (totalAmount) totalAmount.textContent = 'USD 0';
                        return;
        }
        cartButtons.forEach(function (btn) { btn.classList.add('has-items'); });
                    if (countBadge) countBadge.textContent = cartData.length + (cartData.length === 1 ? ' item' : ' items');
        
        let total = 0;
        let html = '';
        cartData.forEach(function (item) {
            const price = parseFloat(item.product_price || item.price) || 0;
            total += price;

            html += '<div class="cart-item" data-package-id="' + item.package_id + '">';
            html += '<div class="cart-item-info">';
            html += '<div class="cart-item-name">' + (item.brand_product_name || item.package_name || item.name || '') + '</div>';
                            html += '<div class="cart-item-price">' + item.currency + ' ' + price.toLocaleString('en-US') + '</div>';
                        html += '</div>';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-times cart-item-remove"></i>';
            html += '</div>';
        });

        if (itemsContainer) itemsContainer.innerHTML = html;
                    if (totalAmount) totalAmount.textContent = 'USD ' + total.toLocaleString('en-US');
            }

    window.loadCartData = function () {
                    const cartCookieName = getCartCookieName();
            const guestCart = getCookie(cartCookieName);

            if (guestCart) {
                try {
                    const cartData = JSON.parse(guestCart);
                    updateCartDisplay(cartData);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('解析 Cookie 購物車失敗（可能是舊的加密格式）:', e);
                    document.cookie = cartCookieName + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
                    updateCartDisplay([]);
                }
            } else {
                updateCartDisplay([]);
            }
            };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const cartDropdown = document.querySelector('.cart-dropdown');
        if (!cartDropdown) return;

        setTimeout(function () {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-cart-package]').forEach(function (button) {
                const packageId = button.getAttribute('data-cart-package');
                if (packageId && typeof window.isInCart === 'function' && window.isInCart(packageId)) {
                    const cartAction = (button.getAttribute('data-cart') || '').toLowerCase();
                    button.classList.add('added');
                    if (cartAction === 'add_to_cart' || cartAction === 'add_cart') {
                        const img = button.querySelector('img');
                        const span = button.querySelector('span');
                        if (img) {
                            img.src = '/images/addedcart.svg';
                            if (span) span.textContent = 'Added to Cart';
                        } else if (span) {
                            span.textContent = 'Added to Cart';
                        } else if (button.tagName && (button.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'button' || button.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a')) {
                            button.innerHTML = '<span>Added to Cart</span>';
                        } else {
                            button.textContent = 'Added to Cart';
                        }
                        try { button.disabled = true; } catch (e) { }
                    }
                }
            });
        }, 100);

                    loadCartData();
        
                fetch('/api/cart/checkGuestCartSync', {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content'),
                            }
        })
        .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (data.error === 0 && data.need_sync && data.cart_data) {
                const cartData = data.cart_data;
                const currentCookieName = getCartCookieName();
                const currentLang = 'en';
                const targetCurrency = currentLang === 'tw' ? 1 : 2;

                const langItems = [];
                cartData.forEach(function(item) {
                    if (item.currency == targetCurrency) {
                        langItems.push({
                            package_id: item.brand_product_id,
                            brand_product_name: item.brand_product_name || item.title || '',
                            product_price: item.brand_product_price || item.price || 0,
                            currency: item.currency == 1 ? 'TWD' : (currentLang === 'en' ? 'USD' : 'RMB'),
                            checked: item.checked == 1,
                            brand: item.brand || 1,
                            product_url: item.product_url || '',
                            report_number: item.report_number || ''
                        });
                    }
                });

                setCookie(currentCookieName, JSON.stringify(langItems), 525600);
                updateCartDisplay(langItems);
            }
        })
        .catch(function(error) {});

        cartDropdown.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target.classList.contains('cart-item-remove')) {
                const item = e.target.closest('.cart-item');
                if (item) {
                    const packageId = item.dataset.packageId;

                    const confirmMessage = 'Remove this item from the cart?';
                    if (!confirm(confirmMessage)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    item.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                    item.style.opacity = '0';
                    item.style.transform = 'translateX(20px)';

                    setTimeout(function() {
                                                    removeCookieItem(packageId);
                                            }, 300);
                }
            }
        });

    function removeCookieItem(packageId) {
        fetch('/api/cart/removePackage', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ package_id: packageId })
        })
        .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (data.error === 0) {
                const cartCookieName = getCartCookieName();
                const guestCart = getCookie(cartCookieName);
                if (guestCart) {
                    try {
                        let cartData = JSON.parse(guestCart);
                        cartData = cartData.filter(function(item) { return item.package_id != packageId; });
                        setCookie(cartCookieName, JSON.stringify(cartData), 525600);
                        updateCartDisplay(cartData);
                        restoreCartButton(packageId);
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('更新 Cookie 失敗:', e);
                    }
                }
            }
        })
        .catch(function(error) {
            console.error('移除失敗:', error);
        });
    }

    function removeFromCart(packageId) {
        fetch('/api/cart/removePackage', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ package_id: packageId })
        })
        .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (data.error === 0) {
                const userId = '';
                if (userId) {
                    document.cookie = 'user_cart_' + userId + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
                }
                loadCartData();
                restoreCartButton(packageId);
            }
        })
        .catch(function(error) {
            console.error('移除失敗:', error);
        });
    }

    function restoreCartButton(packageId) {
        if (!packageId) return;

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-cart-package="' + packageId + '"]').forEach(function(button) {
            const cartAction = (button.getAttribute('data-cart') || '').toLowerCase();
            button.classList.remove('added');

            if (cartAction !== 'add_to_cart' && cartAction !== 'add_cart') return;

            button.disabled = false;
            const img = button.querySelector('img');
            const span = button.querySelector('span');
            const addToCartText = 'Add to Cart';

            if (img) {
                img.src = button.classList.contains('cart-icon-btn') ? '/images/addcart-g.svg' : '/images/addcart.svg';
                img.alt = 'addcart';
                if (span) span.textContent = addToCartText;
            } else if (span) {
                span.textContent = addToCartText;
            } else if (button.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'button' || button.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                if (button.id === 'btnAddToCart') {
                    button.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-shopping-cart" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>' + addToCartText + '</span>';
                } else if (button.classList.contains('add-cart-btn')) {
                    button.innerHTML = '<img src="/images/addcart.svg" alt="addcart"><span>' + addToCartText + '</span>';
                } else {
                    button.innerHTML = '<span>' + addToCartText + '</span>';
                }
            } else {
                button.textContent = addToCartText;
            }
        });
    }

    function mergeGuestCartOnLogin() {
        const cartCookieName = getCartCookieName();
        const guestCart = getCookie(cartCookieName);
        if (!guestCart) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const cartData = JSON.parse(guestCart);
            if (cartData.length === 0) {
                document.cookie = cartCookieName + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
                return;
            }

            let mergePromises = cartData.map(function(item) {
                return fetch('/api/cart/addPackage', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-TOKEN': 'ngA8ZDzMJmJxH5J3D2iAI1kIVIj7Xy8AT0JIFuN9'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        package_id: item.package_id,
                        report_number: item.report_number,
                        checked: 'true'
                    })
                })
                .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
                .then(function(json) {
                    if (json.error === 0) {
                        return { success: true, item: item };
                    } else if (json.error === 2) {
                        return { success: true, item: item, duplicate: true };
                    } else {
                        return { success: false, item: item };
                    }
                })
                .catch(function(error) {
                    console.error('合併商品錯誤:', item.package_name, error);
                    return { success: false, item: item };
                });
            });

            Promise.all(mergePromises).then(function(results) {
                document.cookie = cartCookieName + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';

                const userId = '';
                if (userId) {
                    document.cookie = 'user_cart_' + userId + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
                }

                loadCartData();
            });

        } catch (e) {
            console.error('合併訪客購物車失敗:', e);
            document.cookie = cartCookieName + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
        }
    }
    });

    (function () {
        var _lastCartRefresh = 0;
        var CART_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 10000;

        function syncGuestCartFromExternal() {
            var csrfMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
            fetch('/api/cart/checkGuestCartSync', {
                method: 'GET',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfMeta ? csrfMeta.getAttribute('content') : ''
                }
            })
            .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                if (data.error === 0 && data.cart_data) {
                    var currentCookieName = getCartCookieName();
                    var currentLang = 'en';
                    var targetCurrency = currentLang === 'tw' ? 1 : 2;
                    var langItems = [];
                    data.cart_data.forEach(function(item) {
                        if (item.currency == targetCurrency) {
                            langItems.push({
                                package_id: item.brand_product_id,
                                brand_product_name: item.brand_product_name || item.title || '',
                                product_price: item.brand_product_price || item.price || 0,
                                currency: item.currency == 1 ? 'TWD' : (currentLang === 'en' ? 'USD' : 'RMB'),
                                checked: item.checked == 1,
                                brand: item.brand || 1,
                                product_url: item.product_url || '',
                                report_number: item.report_number || ''
                            });
                        }
                    });
                    setCookie(currentCookieName, JSON.stringify(langItems), 525600);
                    updateCartDisplay(langItems);
                } else {
                    window.loadCartData();
                }
            })
            .catch(function() {
                window.loadCartData();
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            var wrapper = document.querySelector('.cart-button-wrapper');
            if (!wrapper) return;

            wrapper.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - _lastCartRefresh < CART_REFRESH_INTERVAL) return;
                _lastCartRefresh = now;

                                    syncGuestCartFromExternal();
                            });
        });
    })();

    window.clearUserCartCookie = function() {
        try {
            document.cookie = 'cart_tw=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
            document.cookie = 'cart_en=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
            document.cookie = 'guest_id=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
        } catch (e) {
            try { document.cookie = 'cart_tw=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;'; } catch (e) {}
            try { document.cookie = 'cart_en=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;'; } catch (e) {}
            try { document.cookie = 'guest_id=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;'; } catch (e) {}
        }
    };
</script>

<script>
    // 自動為指向 /api/cart/toList 的連結與 window.open/location.assign 附加 guest_id
    (function () {
        function safeGetCookie(name) {
            try {
                if (typeof window.getCookie === 'function') return window.getCookie(name);
                var v = document.cookie.match('(^|;)\\s*' + name + '\\s*=\\s*([^;]+)');
                return v ? decodeURIComponent(v.pop()) : null;
            } catch (e) { return null; }
        }

        function appendGuestIdToUrl(url) {
            try {
                if (!url || url.indexOf('/api/cart/toList') === -1) return url;
                var guest = safeGetCookie('guest_id');
                if (!guest) return url;
                if (url.indexOf('guest_id=') !== -1) return url;
                var sep = url.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&';
                return url + sep + 'guest_id=' + encodeURIComponent(guest);
            } catch (e) { return url; }
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
            var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
            if (!a) return;
            var href = a.getAttribute('href');
            if (!href) return;
            if (href.indexOf('/api/cart/toList') === -1) return;

            var newHref = appendGuestIdToUrl(href);
            if (newHref === href) return;

            e.preventDefault();
            if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || a.target === '_blank' || e.button === 1) {
                window.open(newHref, '_blank');
                return;
            }

            window.location.href = newHref;
        }, true);

        (function () {
            var origOpen = window.open;
            window.open = function(url, name, specs){
                try { if (typeof url === 'string') url = appendGuestIdToUrl(url); } catch (e) {}
                return origOpen.call(window, url, name, specs);
            };
        })();

        try {
            var origAssign = window.location.assign;
            window.location.assign = function(url){
                try { if (typeof url === 'string') url = appendGuestIdToUrl(url); } catch (e) {}
                return origAssign.call(window.location, url);
            };
        } catch (e) {}
    })();
</script>
    <!-- guest_id cookie already set by shared script at top of file -->
                                        </div>
</header>

                            <div class="">

                                                                        <div class="row d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center margin-b-30">
                                        <div class="col">
                                            <p class="text-left margin-r-10">Keyword</p>

<script>
    // 條件篩選(立即觸發)
    $('.select-topic').multiselect(
        {
            includeSelectAllOption: true,
            buttonWidth: '100%',
            selectAllText: 'Select All',
            selectAllValue: 'all',
            nonSelectedText: 'Please Select',
            allSelectedText: 'All',
            onSelectAll: function () {
                const currentSelect = $($(this)[0].$select[0]);
                let eleId = currentSelect.prop('id');
                if ('select-resource' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-resource').val(currentSelect.val());
                }
                if ('select-column' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-column').val(currentSelect.val());
                }
            },
            onDeselectAll: function () {
                const currentSelect = $($(this)[0].$select[0]);
                let eleId = currentSelect.prop('id');
                if ('select-resource' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-resource').val('');
                }
                if ('select-column' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-column').val('');
                }
            },
            onChange: function (option, checked) {
                const selectElement = $(option).parent();
                let eleId = selectElement.prop('id');
                if ('select-resource' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-resource').val(selectElement.val());
                }
                if ('select-column' == eleId) {
                    $('#search-column').val(selectElement.val());
                }
            }
        }
    );
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {
        if ($(window).width() < 768) {
            $('#demo').removeClass('in');
        } else {
            $('#demo').addClass('in');
        }

        // 搜尋結果計數
        $('.result-label').each(function (idx, el) {
            let numberTxt = parseInt($(el).data('number'));
            if (numberTxt >= 999) {
                numberTxt = '999+';
            }
            $(el).html(numberTxt);
        });

        // 排序動態
        $('[data-result_sort]').click(function (el) {
            let sortText = el.target.text;
            let sort = el.target.dataset.result_sort;
            $('#sort-by').html(`${sortText} <i class="fa fa-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>`);
            $('#query-sort').val(sort);
            $('#search-form').submit();
        });

        // 結果頁籤
        $('[data-result_tab]').click(function (el) {
            let tab = el.target.dataset.result_tab;
            $('#tab-resource').val(tab);
            $('#query-page').val(1);
            $('#search-form').submit();
        });

        // 進階搜尋開合
        $('.btn-advanced-search').click(function () {
            let expended = $(this).attr('aria-expanded');
            if (expended == 'true') {
                $(this).find('span').html('<i class="fa fa-caret-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>');
            } else {
                $(this).find('span').html('<i class="fa fa-caret-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>');
            }
        });

        // 條件篩選
        $('#date').daterangepicker({
            showDropdowns: true,
            minYear: 1970,
            maxYear: 2027,
            ranges: {
                "Today": [moment(), moment()],
                "Past Month": [moment().subtract(29, 'days'), moment()],
                "Past Quarter": [moment().subtract(89, 'days'), moment()],
                "Past 6 Months": [moment().subtract(179, 'days'), moment()],
                "Past Year": [moment().subtract(359, 'days'), moment()],
            },
            "locale": {
                "format": "Y/M/D",
                "applyLabel": "OK",
                "cancelLabel": "Cancel",
                "customRangeLabel": "Custom Range",
                "daysOfWeek": [
                    "Sun",
                    "Mon",
                    "Tue",
                    "Wed",
                    "Thu",
                    "Fri",
                    "Sat"
                ],
                "monthNames": [
                    "January",
                    "February",
                    "March",
                    "April",
                    "May",
                    "June",
                    "July",
                    "August",
                    "September",
                    "October",
                    "November",
                    "December"
                ],
                "firstDay": 1
            },
            "alwaysShowCalendars": true,
            "parentEl": ".search-filter-slider",
            endDate: '2026/08/18',
            startDate: '2021/08/18',
        }, function(start, end, label) {
            console.log('New date range selected: ' + start.format('YYYY-MM-DD') + ' to ' + end.format('YYYY-MM-DD') + ' (predefined range: ' + label + ')');
        });

        // 動態綁定,分類區塊toggle
        $('#search-result').on('click', '[data-result_category_toggle]', function (el) {
            const toggleCategories = $(el.target).parents('[data-result_category]').find('.title-link');
            const hideItem = $(el.target).data('result_category_hide');
            let display = false;
            toggleCategories.each(function (idx, el2) {
                if (idx > 1) {
                    if ($(el2).css('display') == 'none') {
                        display = true;
                        $(el2).css('display', 'inline');
                    } else {
                        $(el2).css('display', 'none');
                    }
                }
            });
            if (display) {
                $(el.target).html('-');
            } else {
                $(el.target).html('+' + hideItem);
            }
        })
    });

</script>

        </div>

<script
  src="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=6LeXsBYmAAAAACtiRX4fJHLQYceYn-RyZWrUcURv"></script>
<script>
  $(document).ready(function () {
    $('#btn-contact-inquery').on("click", function () {
      const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');
      const transError = {
        email: 'The E-mail Address must be a valid email address.',
        message: 'Message cannot be empty!',
      };

      const form = document.getElementById('contact-us-popup-form');
      let fromMail = form.from.value;
      let emailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(fromMail);
      if (!emailValid) {
        alert(transError.email);
        return false;
      }
      if (form.message.value.trim() === '' || /^\s*$/.test(form.message.value)) {
        alert(transError.message);
        return false;
      }

      $(this).attr('disabled', true);

      grecaptcha.ready(function () {
        grecaptcha.execute('6LeXsBYmAAAAACtiRX4fJHLQYceYn-RyZWrUcURv', { action: 'contactSales' }).then(function (token) {
          fetch('/api/contact/inquiry', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken,
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              from: document.getElementById('contactFromEmail').value,
              message: document.getElementById('contactMessage').value,
              recaptcha: token,
              url: window.location.href
            }),
          })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
              console.log('json', data);
              $('#btn-contact-inquery').attr('disabled', false);
              if (data.error == 0) {
                $.magnificPopup.close();
              }
              alert(data.message);
            })
            .catch((error) => {
              console.log('error', error);
              alert('Error: sent failed');
              $('#btn-contact-inquery').attr('disabled', false);
            });
        });
      });
    });

    $('#btn-contact-close').on("click", function () {
      $.magnificPopup.close();
    });

    // 會員方案專用的 simple-inquiry 邏輯
    $('#btn-contact-membership-inquery').on("click", function () {
      const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');
      const transError = {
        email: 'The E-mail Address must be a valid email address.',
        message: 'Message cannot be empty!',
      };

      const form = document.getElementById('contact-us-membership-form');
      let emailVal = form.email.value;
      let emailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(emailVal);
      if (!emailValid) {
        alert(transError.email);
        return false;
      }
      if (form.message.value.trim() === '' || /^\s*$/.test(form.message.value)) {
        alert(transError.message);
        return false;
      }

      $(this).attr('disabled', true);

      fetch('/api/contact/simple-inquiry', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: document.getElementById('contactFromEmailMembership').value,
          message: document.getElementById('contactMessageMembership').value,
          package_id: document.getElementById('contactPackageIdMembership').value || null
        }),
      })
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => {
          console.log('json', data);
          $('#btn-contact-membership-inquery').attr('disabled', false);
          if (data.error == 0) {
            $.magnificPopup.close();
          }
          alert(data.message);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.log('error', error);
          alert('Error: sent failed');
          $('#btn-contact-membership-inquery').attr('disabled', false);
        });
    });

    $('#btn-contact-membership-close').on("click", function () {
      $.magnificPopup.close();
      $('#contactPackageIdMembership').val('');
    });

    // 會員方案頁面：從按鈕取得 package_id 並填入隱藏欄位
    $(document).on('mousedown touchstart click', '[href="#contact-sales-membership"], .membership-contactus-btn', function (e) {
      var $el = $(this);
      var pkg = $el.data('package-id') || $el.attr('data-package-id') || $el.data('cart-package') || $el.attr('data-cart-package');
      if (!pkg) {
        var $a = $el.closest('a[href="#contact-sales-membership"]');
        pkg = $a.data('package-id') || $a.attr('data-package-id') || $a.data('cart-package') || $a.attr('data-cart-package');
      }
      $('#contactPackageIdMembership').val(pkg ? pkg : '');
    });

    // Footer 電子報訂閱：用原生 form submit + hidden iframe 避免 CORS 問題
    $('#footer-subscribe-form').on('submit', function () {
      var $form = $(this);
      var $btn = $form.find('.subscribe-btn');
      var $msg = $('#footer-subscribe-msg');

      $btn.prop('disabled', true).text('Submitting...');
      $msg.hide();

      $('#subscribe-frame').off('load').one('load', function () {
        $msg.text('Thanks for subscribing! Please check your inbox to confirm.')
          .css('color', '#81B743').show();
        $form.find('input[name="email"]').val('');
        $btn.prop('disabled', false).text('Subscribe');
      });
    });

    // Footer 語系切換下拉（跟 Header 那組是各自獨立的 DOM，Header 的
    // document.querySelector('.language-button.active') 只會抓到第一個，
    // 這裡另外綁一份、限定在 .site-footer 範圍內）
    var $footerLanguageIcon = $('.site-footer .language-button');
    var $footerLanguageContent = $('.site-footer .header_language-content');

    $footerLanguageIcon.on('click', function () {
      $footerLanguageContent.css('display', 'flex');
    });

    $footerLanguageContent.on('mouseleave', function () {
      $footerLanguageContent.css('display', 'none');
    });

  });
</script>
